reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0084 and p0065 are plain fee-payment/maintenance-fee provisions with no most-favoured-nation, best-pricing, or third-party-offer-matching mechanic in either direction.
Consistent with the rule's preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); there is no Vendor-granted MFN that needs preserving, so no edit is required.
No redline and no counterparty comment were produced, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is byte-identical to the originals and deterministic checks are clean.

Rationale documents the search terms used ('favo', 'no less favourable', 'lowest price', 'other customers', etc.), giving reasonable assurance the absence conclusion is not merely a sampling artefact of the two cited paragraphs.
